subject: Renewal: EU sovereign primary + APAC cold-burst plan — amendment and SOW
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal horizon + EU residency requirement and APAC pilot

Marcus —

Thanks for the conversation yesterday. We are at renewal for our enterprise agreement on May 1 and have two requests we need to fold into the next term:

1) EU sovereign deployment: our privacy/compliance team is asking that the EU region run on a sovereign-tier control plane with customer-managed KMS and a dedicated tenancy for logs. This is a hard requirement for EU customers.

2) APAC pilot: we want to enable an APAC pilot for 3 months as a cold-burst standby (only used for DR and peak traffic during APAC working hours) with the option to convert to primary later.

Can you send a short SOW and a high-level pricing delta for these? Also need a proposal that keeps our support SLA at P99 latency targets for the EU primary. We have procurement joining the thread: I can loop Marco from CloudBroker (our cloud integrator) if helpful.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we have an internal sign-off meeting on 04/15.

—Alex
Alex Carter
Head of Platform Ops, Greenline Health
alex.carter@greenlinehealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal horizon + EU residency requirement and APAC pilot

Alex —

Thanks, and congrats on the upcoming renewal window. High-level responses below; attached is an initial SOW draft and a technical note on the EU sovereign node design.

EU sovereign primary (what we propose):
- Deploy a dedicated EU control plane instance for Greenline with customer KMS integration (BYOK via KMS).
- Dedicated logging tenancy with retention partitioning and optional export to your archival S3 in eu-central-1.
- SLA: we can commit to the enterprise P99 latency objective in the EU region under the dedicated tenancy. Small uplift to the monthly commit due to isolated capacity.

APAC cold-burst pilot (3 months):
- APAC will be configured as a cold standby region: node pools are pre-provisioned but not serving traffic except during scheduled DR tests and declared peak windows.
- Warmup time target: 5–15 minutes to accept traffic; documented runbook included.
- Option to convert to primary within the pilot period with a one-click conversion SOW.

Pricing delta and term options included in the attached SOW. Two commercial paths: 1) extend 1 year with a modest capacity uplift to cover EU dedicated nodes + APAC cold pool; 2) 2-year commit with a commit discount and a conversion credit if you convert APAC to primary within 12 months.

Next steps I suggest:
- I’ll loop Karthik in for contract amendment language around residency and KMS.
- Grace will coordinate the SRE runbook and validation tests with your platform team.

I’ve attached Greenline_SOW_v1.pdf and a technical note. Let me know if you want a call this week.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: Greenline_SOW_v1.pdf, EU-Sovereign-Node-Design.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Alex Carter <alex.carter@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal horizon + EU residency requirement and APAC pilot

Alex / Marcus —

Quick legal/contract note on the amendment:
- We can draft an addendum that seats the EU control plane under a separate tenancy agreement and includes KMS BYOK clauses; we will explicitly state that logs are customer-owned and provide export tooling.
- Need to confirm data egress obligations for the APAC cold-burst (even if cold). If you require zero egress of EU-origin customer PII to APAC replicas, we must add geo-fencing rules and technical proof points.
- Term change options: 12-month (standard) or 24-month (preferred) with the conversion credit. For 24-month commits we can include a one-time credit equal to one monthly commit if APAC is converted to primary in the first 12 months.

I’ll attach a redline to the renewal contract next pass. For procurement, can you clarify whether Marco will sign an MOU for cloud integrator work or if Greenline will manage the APAC infra procurement?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Contracts — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Marco Tanaka <marco@cloudbroker.co.jp>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Carter <alex.carter@greenlinehealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T02:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal horizon + EU residency requirement and APAC pilot

Thanks for the SOW and redline. A couple clarifications from the integrator side:

1) For the EU sovereign node, CloudBroker will provision the networking (VPC peering and transit encryption) and ensure HSM/KMS integration — we will need the KMS policy templates from Redwood to complete the work.

2) APAC cold-burst: CloudBroker recommends keeping a lightweight traffic mirror to a read-only mirror in APAC during the pilot so runbook drills can be validated without full activation. This requires log replication (metadata only) and a short, documented retention for the mirror — acceptable?

3) Pricing: procurement has a preference for the 24-month commit (predictability). They asked for a worked example of monthly cost under the two options versus expected token throughput; can Redwood provide a 12-month forecast matrix?

We can hold a technical kickoff on 04/13 if that works.

—Marco
Marco Tanaka
Senior Cloud Architect — CloudBroker (APAC)
marco@cloudbroker.co.jp
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@greenlinehealth.com>, Marco Tanaka <marco@cloudbroker.co.jp>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal horizon + EU residency requirement and APAC pilot — final next steps

Alex / Marco —

Thanks for the questions and the constructive feedback. Summary / planned commitments: 

1) Contract amendment: Redwood will circulate a redlined amendment that:
   - Adds EU sovereign control plane language, BYOK/KMS clauses, and explicit log ownership/export.
   - Adds geo-fencing clauses preventing EU-origin PII from being replicated to APAC without prior written consent.
   - Documents the 24-month commit option and the conversion credit mechanics.

2) SOW and runbook: we will finalize SOW v1 into v1.1 with the APAC cold-burst mirror design (metadata-only mirror), an activation runbook (5–15 minute ramp target), and a scheduled DR exercise cadence. Grace will coordinate a technical kickoff on 2027-04-20 to validate the runbook with your SREs.

3) Pricing and forecast: attaching a worked example matrix; commercial offer: if you sign the 24-month commit by 2027-04-30 we can apply a 12% commit discount plus a one-time conversion credit (1x monthly commit) if APAC is converted to primary within 12 months.

4) Next steps for procurement: Marco, if CloudBroker will manage APAC infra procurement please confirm and we’ll add an MOU clause; otherwise Greenline will maintain procurement ownership.

I’m attaching the redline and the revised SOW. If these look good to procurement, Karthik will ingest the redline and prep the amendment for signature (DocuSign link included in thread metadata).

Happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
